n0001.title: GPT-3 and the Scaling Hypothesis
n0001.gist: GPT-3's emergent meta-learning validates the scaling hypothesis that raw scale, not clever architecture, drives AI progress, exposing how badly mainstream forecasters misjudged this trajectory.

n0002.title: GPT-3 Announcement
n0002.gist: GPT-3's unexpected meta-learning ability from mere scaling signals that unsupervised large models are becoming central to future deep learning.

n0003.title: GPT-3 Announcement
n0003.gist: GPT-3's scale-driven meta-learning surprised researchers and supports the scaling hypothesis of AGI.

n0006.title: Meta-Learning and Flexing GPT
n0006.gist: GPT-3 learned to learn from prompts alone, and despite using an outdated, unoptimized architecture, it displays startling flexible capabilities that existing benchmarks fail to capture.

n0007.title: Meta-Learning
n0007.gist: GPT-3's next-word training on huge text produced attention mechanisms that function as learned meta-learning.

n0010.title: Flexing GPT
n0010.gist: Despite being a small, outdated, unoptimized model, GPT-3 shows startling creative and meta-learning abilities that standard benchmarks fail to reflect.

n0015.title: Baking The Cake and Scaling
n0015.gist: GPT-3's continued unsupervised gains and clean, unbroken scaling curves show that bigger models remain worth their steep cost.

n0016.title: Baking The Cake
n0016.gist: GPT-3's scaling continued past expectations without diminishing returns, making further scale-up both feasible and worthwhile despite critics calling it too costly.

n0024.title: Scaling
n0024.gist: GPT-3's loss follows clean power-law scaling laws with clear room left before performance saturates.

n0033.title: Blessings Of Scale and Scaling Hypothesis
n0033.gist: Across deep learning, larger models and data consistently unlock generalization and meta-learning as a lucky byproduct of scale, supporting the strong scaling hypothesis that intelligence emerges from simple scaled-up architectures.

n0034.title: Blessings Of Scale
n0034.gist: Numerous deep learning domains show that scale alone induces stability, generalization, and meta-learning by favoring simple sub-models that later generalize as data grows.

n0047.title: Scaling Hypothesis
n0047.gist: The strong scaling hypothesis holds that scaled-up uniform architectures naturally develop sophisticated behavior, a claim the author now believes vindicated.

n0051.title: Why Does Pretraining Work
n0051.gist: The pretraining thesis argues that predicting human text forces a model through increasingly deep levels of understanding, though this claim invites reasonable doubt until GPT-3's results proved it out.

n0052.title: The Pretraining Thesis
n0052.gist: Because human writing encodes reasoning and causality, a model that predicts text well must implicitly learn to generalize and reason.

n0058.title: Stages of Learning to Predict Text
n0058.gist: As training proceeds the model climbs from letter frequencies to spelling to word associations to genuine sentence-level coherence.

n0065.title: The Last Bits Are Deepest
n0065.gist: The final, hardest-won bits of prediction accuracy correspond to true reasoning and understanding, mirroring how rare human decisions matter disproportionately.

n0075.title: Reasons For Doubt
n0075.gist: Though logically sound, the pretraining thesis felt unproven in practice since scaling curves, data limits, or architectural flaws could have stalled progress.

n0080.title: Unanswered Predictions
n0080.gist: No one, by the author's own admission, had quantitatively predicted GPT-3's capabilities or can say what comes next.

n0087.title: Prospects and Critiquing The Critics
n0087.gist: Only OpenAI has bet seriously on scaling while rival labs and skeptical experts have repeatedly and wrongly dismissed the scaling hypothesis, revealing a pattern of confident but unaccountable authority.

n0088.title: Prospects
n0088.gist: Despite having the hardware, major labs like DeepMind and Google Brain lack OpenAI's conviction to bet aggressively on scaling.

n0101.title: A Decade of Underestimated Progress
n0101.gist: The past decade's deep learning explosion, foreseen only by a few connectionist heretics, vindicates their scaling predictions against dismissive mainstream experts.

n0109.title: Authority Without Accountability
n0109.gist: Confident expert reassurances that scaling would fail were consistently wrong, yet these authorities never issued corrections and speak in a tone of certainty regardless of truth.

n0118.title: Appendix
n0118.gist: Generative models trained on human-generated data inevitably absorb agency, and this emergent agency likely extends further than expected since it is a broadly useful, hard-to-exclude capability.

n0119.title: It From Byte
n0119.gist: GPT-3 already exhibits real agency by imitating agentic humans in its training data, and this agency can act in the world once given effectors.

n0128.title: All Is Atoms & Void
n0128.gist: There is no principled boundary between agentic and non-agentic data, since all agency ultimately reduces to ordinary physics.

n0132.title: Intentional Stance and Variational Reasoning
n0132.gist: Treating natural systems through an agent-like variational lens is a natural, efficient shortcut that neural networks are equally likely to adopt.

n0143.title: What Induces Agency Emergence
n0143.gist: Even abstract systems like cellular automata or random Turing machines can, once modeled by simple chunked entities or meta-learned rule induction, edge toward primitive agency.

n0160.title: Ambient Agency
n0160.gist: Agency behaves like a convergent, hard-to-exclude capability that can arise from many routes, so no simple data filtering can guarantee tool AIs stay non-agentic.
